product_family: Dialogflow: conversational AI platform with two product lines - Dialogflow CX (modern, Gemini-powered) and Dialogflow Essentials (legacy). Both support multilingual NLU, text and voice channels, omnichannel integration, and regional data residency. Dialogflow is composed of Google Cloud services (Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, etc.).

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud undergoes regular third-party audits to certify individual products against SOC 2 standards.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: The Google Cloud Services ISMS has received an accredited ISO/IEC 27001 certification after undergoing an audit by an independent third party.

certifications.name: ISO 27017
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains certification including ISO/IEC 27017 (Cloud Privacy standards).

certifications.name: ISO 27018
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains certification including ISO/IEC 27018 (Cloud Privacy standards).

certifications.name: ISO 27701
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains certification including ISO/IEC 27701 (Privacy Information Management).

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Google will assist Customer in ensuring compliance with its obligations under Articles 32 to 34 of the GDPR, by implementing and maintaining Security Measures...Google's updated data processing agreements include audit rights for the benefit of customers who are subject to the GDPR.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Customers subject to HIPAA who want to utilize Google Cloud products in connection with Protected Health Information (PHI) must review and accept Google's Business Associate Agreement (BAA), and Google ensures covered products meet HIPAA requirements and align with ISO/IEC 27001, 27017, and 27018 certifications and SOC 2 reports.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud is a Level 1 PCI DSS 4.0–compliant service provider, which means it can support PCI DSS compliance needs regardless of a company's merchant level. Dialogflow can be integrated with Google's Data Loss Prevention API to handle PCI and sensitive data.

certifications.name: FedRAMP High
certifications.proof_quote: Google Cloud maintains a comprehensive FedRAMP High P-ATO that covers more than 150 cloud services...Since Dialogflow inherits these certifications from Google Cloud's underlying infrastructure, it is covered under this broad FedRAMP authorization.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification for Dialogflow or Google Cloud found.

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR AI certification for Dialogflow found.

privacy.ai_training_note: Dialogflow Essentials has opt-in data logging where Google may retain Customer Training Data indefinitely and train machine learning models. Quote: 'When data logging is enabled, customers provide Customer Training Data to Google to develop, improve, and model Google's machine learning technology.' Google receives a 'perpetual, irrevocable right to use, de-identify and copy the Customer Training Data.' Customers can disable data logging, but previously logged data is retained by Google. Data deletion requires manual form submission. Dialogflow CX does not have automatic data logging for model training.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region with regional residency control: Americas (US Iowa/South Carolina/Oregon, Montréal), Europe (Belgium, London, Frankfurt, Netherlands, Zurich), Asia-Pacific (Sydney, Tokyo, Mumbai, Singapore, Jakarta). AI/ML Data Location commitment available only in US and EU regions. Once region selected, cannot be changed without data export/restore.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Yes - Google Cloud default encryption for all data at rest

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: Yes - TLS encryption for all data in transit

security.name: Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK)
security.value: Available for Dialogflow CX and Dialogflow ES

security.name: VPC Service Controls
security.value: Available for network-level isolation and security perimeter

security.name: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) integration
security.value: Integrated with Google Cloud DLP to detect, mask, and redact PII, PCI data, and sensitive information. No incremental costs for DLP use in Dialogflow CX.

security.name: Data redaction and retention controls
security.value: Security settings allow configuration of data redaction strategy, scope, and retention window. Changes take up to 1 hour to implement.

security.name: Access Transparency logs
security.value: Available for monitoring authorized personnel access to customer data

security.name: Cloud audit logging
security.value: Organizations can log all conversations to BigQuery, control data location and access via IAM

security.name: External penetration testing
security.value: Google employs external penetration testing by certified testers

security.name: End-user authentication
security.value: Dialogflow does not authenticate end-users directly; customers and third-party integrations are responsible for end-user credential management and access controls

products.name: Dialogflow CX
products.data_scope: Text conversations, voice audio, user interactions stored in project region; ML processing may occur outside region for generative features
products.notes: Modern product line powered by Gemini. Supports 40+ languages, omnichannel (web, mobile, voice, email, social), multimodal (text, audio, images). Default: no data logging for training. Optional: regional data residency (US/EU/APAC). Includes visual builder, prebuilt templates, agent evaluation, tracing. Session-based pricing ($0.50/voice or chat per session with limits).

products.name: Dialogflow Essentials
products.data_scope: Text conversations, audio speech data. Opt-in data logging stores indefinitely for model training. Non-logged data encrypted at rest in region.
products.notes: Legacy product line. Supports speech-to-text, text-to-speech, intent recognition. Optional enhanced speech models require opt-in data logging where Google trains on customer data. Data deletion requires manual form submission. Smaller team/startup focus. If HIPAA-covered: must not enable data logging.

compare.pricing_model: Session-based usage pricing (Dialogflow CX: $0.50/voice or chat session with limits). Pay-as-you-go, no upfront commitment.
compare.data_residency: Supported in 13+ regions: Americas (US, Montréal), Europe (5 cities), Asia-Pacific (5 cities). Multi-region option stores in US. AI/ML Data Location commitment only in US and EU.

flags: The two editions differ in an important way: Dialogflow Essentials has opt-in data logging where Google trains on customer data indefinitely, a major privacy and compliance consideration for regulated industries. Dialogflow CX does not have automatic data logging.

HIPAA-covered entities must not enable data logging in Dialogflow Essentials and must sign Google's Business Associate Agreement (BAA). The documentation states: 'Customers must not have a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) covering Protected Health Information' to enable data logging, meaning that if you have a BAA, you cannot use data logging.
Dialogflow Essentials data logging includes 'indefinite retention' by default. Customers wanting to delete training data must submit a manual form request; deletion is not automatic or self-service.

Even with regional data residency selected, Dialogflow CX's generative AI features (powered by Gemini) may process data outside the selected region; the AI/ML Data Location commitment is limited to the US and EU only.
The data logging terms explicitly prohibit data from websites and apps directed at children under 13.

All Dialogflow certifications are inherited from Google Cloud's certifications. Dialogflow documentation states 'Dialogflow is comprised of other Google Cloud services, such as Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech, and any certifications, security controls, and government authorizations cover Dialogflow in its entirety.' There is no product-specific audit.
No ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance) or CSA STAR AI certifications were found; this may be relevant for AI-regulated sectors.
Data passed through third-party integrations and webhooks may be handled per those providers' privacy policies, outside Dialogflow's control.
